name: Saikyou Chijo Kamitsukasa Reiko Kouhen
original_name: 最凶痴女上司麗子　後編
source:
Main character gets to live together with his boss Reiko. And she reverse sexually harasses him not only at home, but also at work and even during train rides. She stops treating people as human beings. And one day her true face gets revealed.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-july-2007-bullet-butlers.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公开始与上司朝比奈丽子共同生活。无论在家、公司，甚至搭乘列车时，她都会反过来对他实施性骚扰。丽子渐渐不再把他人当人看待，而她的真面目也终于在某一天暴露出来。
